reviews.reviewtitle: some samples give credit to originating foundries
reviews.reviewbody: In a rare move, this catalog has a section near end titled “Desirable Styles of Modern Jobbing Faces Manufactured by Other Foundries” in which typefaces are credited to their originating foundry.
